title: SPARCS enables scalable recovery of complex image-based phenotypes for genetic screening
title_zh: SPARCS：一种可扩展的空间分辨CRISPR筛选平台，用于复杂图像表型的遗传筛选
abstract: Forward genetic screening links genotype to phenotype by introducing random genetic perturbations and identifying phenotype-altering mutations. Although genome-scale screens are routine for simple phenotypes in cultured cells, extending them to complex image-based phenotypes remains challenging. Here, we present spatially resolved CRISPR screening (SPARCS), a microscopy-based platform for forward genetic screening on single-cell images. SPARCS physically isolates mutants in situ by automated laser microdissection, enabling image-based screening at unprecedented scale with multimodal hit phenotyping. We demonstrate SPARCS in genome-wide CRISPR knockout screens of autophagosome formation and activation of the immune sensor STING across 70 million cells. Via machine learning-based image analysis, SPARCS recovered most macroautophagy genes and identified GPHR as a pH-dependent regulator of STING. Mass spectrometry-based proteomics of isolated hit cells revealed endoplasmic reticulum (ER)/Golgi disruption and nominated additional STING regulators via in silico perturbation modeling. These results establish SPARCS as a scalable platform for genome-wide genetic screening of complex cellular phenotypes with a proteome-level readout.
abstract_zh: 正向遗传筛选通过引入随机基因扰动并识别改变表型的突变，来关联基因型与表型。虽然在培养细胞中对简单表型进行基因组规模的筛选已成为常规，但将其扩展到复杂的图像表型仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了空间分辨CRISPR筛选（SPARCS），一种基于显微镜的单细胞图像正向遗传筛选平台。SPARCS通过自动激光微切割在原位物理隔离突变体，使得在前所未有的规模下进行基于图像的筛选，并实现多模态命中表型分析。我们在70万细胞中对自噬体形成和免疫传感器STING激活进行全基因组CRISPR敲除筛选，展示了SPARCS的应用。通过基于机器学习的图像分析，SPARCS恢复了大多数宏自噬基因，并识别出GPHR为pH依赖性STING调节因子。对分离出的命中细胞进行基于质谱的蛋白组学分析，揭示了内质网（ER）/高尔基体的破坏，并通过计算机模拟扰动模型进一步筛选出其他STING调节因子。这些结果确立了SPARCS作为一种可扩展的平台，用于对复杂细胞表型进行基因组规模的遗传筛选，并提供蛋白组水平的读数。
